About this item

  • CONVENIENT 6-PACK VALUE - Stock up on everyday essentials with six comfortable crewneck undershirts designed for dependable fit, everyday performance, and trusted Hanes quality.
  • EVERYDAY COTTON COMFORT - Made from soft, breathable cotton (heather styles are a cotton/polyester blend), these men's undershirts provide lightweight comfort for layering or wearing on their own.
  • MOISTURE-WICKING PERFORMANCE - Men's t-shirt made with Cool Comfort fabric helps wick away moisture while advanced odor protection helps keep you cool, dry, and feeling fresh throughout the day.
  • DESIGNED TO STAY TUCKED - An extra-long t-shirt hem is designed to stay tucked in, providing dependable coverage and a neat appearance whether you're working, traveling, or going about your day.
  • CLASSIC COMFORT - A lay-flat crewneck collar and tag-free design help deliver lasting comfort while creating a clean look under button-downs, polos, sweaters, and t-shirts.

Product Description

This Hanes® men’s t-shirt multi-pack takes a basic you thought you knew and makes it even better. You'll love the lay-flat crewneck collar, tag-free design, and extra-long length that ensures these essential men’s undershirts stay tucked in. Made with Cool Comfort® moisture-wicking fabric, you’ll stay cool and comfortable no matter how long your day is. Stock up on these cotton tees in a convenient multi-pack and start wearing a better-than-basic undershirt.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

  • Andrew
    5 out of 5 stars
    Excellent shirts if this is what you're looking for
    Reviewed in the United States on August 9, 2026
    Size: X-LargeColor: White - 6 Pack
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    During COVID I ordered some Hanes shirts that were the exact style that I already had and when they arrived they were extremely short and poorly sewn. This almost made me stop wearing Hanes completely but after wearing them for 20+ years it's hard to change, so I gave them another try recently.

    Seems to me that Hanes is back! These shirts are excellent. They fit perfectly and they look and feel l great. However, here are a few things people should know.

    1) They may actually be thinner than in previous years. For me, that is a good thing. I'm not wearing a t-shirt because I need extra warmth but because I want cotton between my skin and the outter. It's softer, cooler, and catches my sweat. Thick undershirts make no sense IMO, but not feels that way (as you can see in the other reviews).

    2) Out of the package, they feel kind of crusty. This made me worried at first, but I Googled it and learned that they should soften up after a few washes. Today they are on wash number three and they feel like a normal soft t-shirt (which is why I'm leaving this review now). So it may take a couple of washes for them to feel the way you want.

About this Item

  • CONVENIENT 6-PACK VALUE - Stock up on everyday essentials with six comfortable crewneck undershirts designed for dependable fit, everyday performance, and trusted Hanes quality.
  • EVERYDAY COTTON COMFORT - Made from soft, breathable cotton (heather styles are a cotton/polyester blend), these men's undershirts provide lightweight comfort for layering or wearing on their own.
  • MOISTURE-WICKING PERFORMANCE - Men's t-shirt made with Cool Comfort fabric helps wick away moisture while advanced odor protection helps keep you cool, dry, and feeling fresh throughout the day.
  • DESIGNED TO STAY TUCKED - An extra-long t-shirt hem is designed to stay tucked in, providing dependable coverage and a neat appearance whether you're working, traveling, or going about your day.
  • CLASSIC COMFORT - A lay-flat crewneck collar and tag-free design help deliver lasting comfort while creating a clean look under button-downs, polos, sweaters, and t-shirts.

Product Description

Men's cotton undershirts are designed to provide breathable comfort and reliable layering for everyday wear. This Hanes crewneck undershirt 6-pack combines soft cotton fabric with Cool Comfort moisture-wicking fabric to help wick away moisture and advanced odor protection to help keep you feeling fresh throughout the day. A classic crewneck collar is designed to lay flat under clothing, while the tag-free interior helps eliminate distractions for lasting comfort. The extra-long length is designed to stay tucked in whether you're at work, on the go, or relaxing at home, while the classic fit offers comfortable wear on its own or layered under your favorite shirts. Available in assorted colors and packaged in a convenient six-pack, these everyday essentials deliver the comfort, performance, and trusted Hanes quality you count on. For best results, machine wash this men's t-shirt in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low to help maintain comfort, fit, and fabric performance over time.
